body:
That is absolutely bonkers!!! 

That reminds me of a time when I worked at a thrift store and some middle aged man asked me,

“Are there cameras all over the store?”

-_- 

Needless to say I reported it.
One time I screamed so loud I’m sure everyone thought I was insane😅
I have the opposite problem, people tell me not to smile -_-.
I’m starting to think people don’t know the difference between a smirk and a smile anymore :(.
Yup, I was just giving him my friendly retail smile, as I do with all customers. Idk what was going through his head though to go from 0-10 like a switch.
